description: This file defines a SwiftUI view modifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand when hovering over a view, managing cursor state with NSCursor and handling hover events.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand on hover and manages cursor state.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor
methods.description: A View extension method that applies the PointingHandCursorModifier to a view.
